description: Preserve Self-EvolveRec’s diagnostic interface while adapting its probes to the trained recommendation architecture and the information available in RecHarness. DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader) returns metrics and metric_definitions. The view exposes the actual trained model and compatible embedding, sequence-encoding, scoring, and history interfaces.
motivation: Make diagnostics useful for model improvement without relying on unavailable attributes, fabricated simulator traits, or hidden test outcomes. Select improvements using macro-average validation HR@10 across all four Amazon datasets.
implementation_notes: Retain dataset routing for Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Adapt probes whenever the architecture changes. Use only public interaction histories, titles, descriptions, and timestamps; review content, ratings, item categories, prices, stores, and simulator diversity/conformity traits are unavailable. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Keep DATA_DIR sourced from os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], artifacts within the trial directory, and predictor generation consistent with the trained architecture. Preserve preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and the environment default of 200 epochs. No experimental results are supplied.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device):
        store view and device
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        put view.model in evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            inspect sequence features and candidate scores through compatible view methods
            compute supported diagnostics using valid, non-padding positions
            generate unseen-item recommendations for five training users per category
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_values, metric_definitions: definitions_and_availability}

Select trials by the pinned evaluator's macro validation HR@10.

originality.positive: Connects a native diagnostic workflow to a constrained, reproducible recommendation benchmark.
originality.negative: Primarily an interface and evaluation adaptation; no new recommendation algorithm is specified.

future_potential.positive: Could support systematic diagnosis and architecture changes while keeping trial selection comparable.
future_potential.negative: Whether diagnostics improve validation performance remains untested; unavailable behavioral traits limit interpretation.

code_difficulty.positive: The required interface and batch contract are explicit, making a baseline adapter straightforward.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-specific probes, full-catalog scoring, correct masking, and matching predictor serialization require careful implementation. Score denotes moderate difficulty on a 1–10 scale.
